title: erigeron × vierhapperi
intro: Erigeron × vierhapperi, commonly known as the Vierhapper's Fleabane or Alpine Fleabane, is a perennial plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is native to the mountainous regions of the western United States and Canada, where it grows in rocky areas and meadows. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and inflammation due to its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and sedative effects. Erigeron × vierhapperi contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
